description: Ministry of Higher Education and Highways - Order to amend by adding "13. Dept. of Microbiology,  14. Dept. of Parasitology" to the Act (Schedule) of the University of Jaffna that published in Gaz. Ex. Ordinary No. 1518/15 of October 09th, 2007
reasoning: This gazette content primarily involves a legal/regulatory matter - specifically an amendment to the Universities Act, No. 16 of 1978. It contains an order issued under Section 27(1) of the Act that modifies the schedule specifying faculties and departments of the University of Jaffna. While it mentions Minister Lakshman Kiriella, this is incidental to the main purpose of publishing a legal amendment. The content focuses on regulatory changes to university structure rather than government personnel changes or detailed portfolio responsibilities, making it a Legal/Regulatory Gazette (Type 5).
